simple.meaning: a reservoir ; by analogy, a marsh

definitions.short: a reservoir ; by analogy, a marsh
definitions.full: H1360. gebe גֶּ֫בֶא noun masculine Ezek 47:11 cistern, pool (compare Arabic watering-trough ) — 1 cistern מִגֶּ֑בֶא מַיִם Isa 30:14 . 2 pool, marsh גְּבָיָאו Ezek 47:11 (|| כִּצּאֹתָ֯ו ). גבב (probably be curved, convex, elevated , Aramaic גִּבְּבָא hill; be or make hollow, dig , Arabic cut off or out , , Aramaic גֹּב , Ethiopic , Assyrian gubbu , — all = cistern ; compare e.g. Assyrian gubbâni ša mê, cisterns of water , Asrb Annals Col. viii. 102 , KB ii. 220 ; see proper name גֹּב below)
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root meaning probably to collect ;
